fast_external_heap.description: Fast external heap run for quick feedback with provider generation enabled and bounded iterations.
fast_external_heap.request: Run heap esterno FAST: preload repo/docs/memoria/tool, operational scratch memory, GPU1 planner, GPU0 companion review, NPU audit breve, proposal chunks concreti con path repo reali, blocca placeholder/stub.

balanced_external_heap.description: Balanced external heap run matching the current validated operator workflow.
balanced_external_heap.request: Run heap esterno BALANCED: usa preload completo repo/docs/memoria/tool, scrivi startup reload nella operational scratch memory, riconcilia artifact utili anche se degradati, usa GPU1 planner, GPU0 companion reviewer/refiner e NPU audit nella stessa evidenza, gestisci output oltre il contesto tramite artifact/chunk/refinement task, produci proposal chunks concreti con path repo reali e blocca placeholder/stub.

deep_external_heap.description: Deep external heap run for stronger refinement pressure and larger startup context.
deep_external_heap.request: Run heap esterno DEEP: massimizza contesto preload repo/docs/memoria/tool, operational scratch memory, più revisioni GPU1/GPU0/NPU, forza proposal chunks concreti con repo-relative paths, rigetta ripetizioni e placeholder/stub, produci package finale di revisione operatore.

strict_startup_external_heap.description: Strict startup profile: preload degradation blocks the launcher before provider work.
strict_startup_external_heap.request: Run heap esterno STRICT STARTUP: fallisci se il preload context/memory/tool/docs degrada; se passa, esegui GPU1/GPU0/NPU e composer finale.

dry_packaging_external_heap.description: Packaging/debug profile: no provider generation, useful for checking preflight/startup/composer wiring.
dry_packaging_external_heap.request: Run heap esterno DRY/PACKAGING: verifica preflight, startup preload, operational memory write, reconciliation e composer packaging senza richiedere provider generation.
